CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   D. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Inspired Word of God.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Balaam’s Donkey? (1 mark)

5. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Patriarchs Abraham? (1 mark)

   D. Use Bible Patriarchs Abraham to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Joseph interprets a Dream? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Joseph interprets a Dream.
   B. Apply the teaching of Joseph interprets a Dream with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Joseph interprets a Dream to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Joseph interprets a Dream has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of My Family Family members? (1 mark)
   A. Use My Family Family members to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of My Family Family members with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say My Family Family members has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Family Family members.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Making choices? (1 mark)
   A. Say Making choices has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Making choices.
   C. Use Making choices to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Making choices with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Samson kills a Lion? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Samson kills a Lion has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Samson kills a Lion to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Samson kills a Lion.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

11. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of God? (1 mark)
   A. Use Attributes of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Attributes of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Thoughts and feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Say Thoughts and feelings has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Thoughts and feelings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Thoughts and feelings.
   D. Apply the teaching of Thoughts and feelings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

14. Which response best shows understanding of The Annunciation? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Annunciation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Annunciation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Joseph interprets a Dream and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Patriarchs Abraham and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
